name: Casters first
text: Goes for the nearest enemy caster, support, summoner, or mimic first, and hits them harder.

name: Hold your ground
text: Stays where it's placed, attacking faster, until an enemy comes within 2 hexes.

name: Wait to heal
text: Holds a healing signature until an ally in its reach is badly hurt; that heal is stronger.

name: Plant your feet
text: Stops walking while an enemy stands within 2 hexes; closes in again when none does.

name: Fliers first
text: Goes for flying enemies first, and hits them harder.

name: Marked first
text: Goes for Marked enemies first, and crits them more often.

name: Finish them
text: Goes for the weakest enemy in reach, and hits enemies near death harder.

name: Break the line
text: Goes for the toughest enemy first, and its hits ignore part of its DEF.

name: Guard the weakest
text: Goes for whoever is attacking its weakest ally, and is tougher while it does.

name: Keep your distance
text: Backs away to keep its target at the edge of its reach, attacking faster there.

name: Stay with the tank
text: Stays near its ally with the most DEF, and is tougher there.

name: Dive
text: Goes for the farthest enemy, hitting harder for the first few seconds.

name: Wait for a crowd
text: Holds an area signature until enough enemies stand in it; then it hits harder.

name: Save it for the kill
text: Holds a damaging signature until its target is below half HP; then it hits harder.
